pkgmetadata.longdescription: Nine script-based Plymouth themes (bentoo-compile-it, bentoo-compile-it-v2, compile-it, funtoo, funtoo-next, funtoo-tux, gentoo, gentoo-maskots, gnu-meditate) derived from darwin-plymouth. They share one script that handles the LUKS passphrase, the TPM2 and security-token PIN prompts of systemd-cryptsetup with a retry warning, question prompts, and boot messages.
